papers.title: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
papers.what: Measures the teacher's per-token supervision during on-policy distillation, finds it noisy in a way that worsens with teacher scale and that the student ignores, shows a single fixed negative advantage reproduces the method, and replaces the teacher with the student's own entropy for a 35.41-point Avg@32 gain on AIME24.
papers.builds_on: DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); Chain-of-Thought Prompting (Wei 2023, HBLPTRMY); DeepSeek-V3 (2024, 2JCKA7GI)

papers.title: P2E-VQ: ECG-linked representation augmentation for PPG via discrete patch retrieval
papers.authors: Wu, Gao, Zhao, Zhou, Lip, Zheng et al. (Liverpool)
papers.what: Replaces ill-posed PPG-to-ECG waveform reconstruction with retrieval: PPG patches are quantised to discrete tokens that index a training-only memory bank of ECG-linked representations, so inference needs PPG alone, beating pretrained baselines on six tasks across five datasets under one frozen-feature linear probe.
papers.builds_on: Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF); Sensor2Text (Chen 2024, ELYUE3NF); SSL for HAR (Yuan 2024, RTMH75VW)

papers.title: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture: Evaluation, Efficiency, and Training Stability
papers.authors: Qiu, Wang, Li, Men, Mao et al. (Qwen)
papers.what: Reports a 125B sparse mixture-of-experts model with 6B activated parameters that mixes Gated DeltaNet with one full-attention layer in four, adds 51B parameters of n-gram embeddings held off the accelerator, and matches a 397B predecessor at roughly one ninth the training FLOPs while showing loss and downstream accuracy come apart.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017, PHB9VRVM); Mamba (Gu 2024, XNI34DQX); Mamba-2 (Dao 2024, JPKDWV2Q)

papers.title: CAST: Critique-Aware Supervision for Training Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Calling Agents
papers.authors: Saeidi, Zhang, Singh, Gupta, Baral et al.
papers.what: Synthesises structured per-action rationales from sparse task outcomes, trains a critique model on them, and uses that critique to reshape the policy, moving reliability from inference-time search into training and beating GPT-OSS-120B by over 10 percent pass^4 on Retail with a further 9 percent out-of-domain on Telehealth.
papers.builds_on: ToolkenGPT (Hao 2024, 6RDHVVA2); LATS (Zhou 2024, 77ERE7HA); Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026, BDY3HUCV)
